# truenas_init_shutdown_script (Resource)

Manages an init/shutdown script (initshutdownscript) on TrueNAS: a command or script executed at a chosen point in the boot or shutdown sequence.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_init_shutdown_script" "mount_check" {
  type    = "SCRIPT"
  script  = "/usr/local/bin/mount-check.sh"
  when    = "POSTINIT"
  enabled = true
  timeout = 15
  comment = "Verify external mounts are present after boot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Type of task: COMMAND (execute a single command) or SCRIPT (execute a script file).
- `when` (String) When to execute: PREINIT (early in boot, before most services start), POSTINIT (late in boot, after most services have started), or SHUTDOWN.

### Optional

- `command` (String) Shell command to execute. Required when type is COMMAND; ignored otherwise. Defaults to an empty string.
- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the purpose of this script. Defaults to an empty string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this init/shutdown script is enabled to execute. Defaults to true.
- `script` (String) Path to a script to execute. Required when type is SCRIPT; ignored otherwise. Defaults to an empty string.
- `timeout` (Number) Time in seconds to wait for the command/script to complete before it is considered timed out. Defaults to 10.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the init/shutdown script.
